detections.abstract_quote: The 1.4 micron water absorption band is detected at high confidence (5.4 sigma) in the planetary atmosphere.

reference.title: Detection of H2O and Evidence for TiO/VO in an Ultra-hot Exoplanet Atmosphere

detections.note: Contested: Evans et al. 2018, 'An Optical Transmission Spectrum for the Ultra-hot Jupiter WASP-121b Measured with the Hubble Space Telescope' (AJ 156, 283; doi:10.3847/1538-3881/aaebff) finds 'no evidence for TiO' (3-sigma upper limit -7.9 dex); Hoeijmakers et al. 2020 (A&A 641, A123; doi:10.1051/0004-6361/202038365) report 'Non-detections of Ti and TiO', attributing it to a Ti cold trap.
detections.abstract_quote: We conclude that scattering by high-altitude haze alone is unlikely to account for this difference, and instead interpret it as evidence for titanium oxide and vanadium oxide absorption.

reference.title: Detection of H2O and Evidence for TiO/VO in an Ultra-hot Exoplanet Atmosphere

detections.note: Tentative in this abstract ('evidence for'). Later papers support VO only indirectly: Evans et al. 2018 (AJ 156, 283; doi:10.3847/1538-3881/aaebff) say the STIS opacity variations 'may instead be explained by VO spectral bands'; Hoeijmakers et al. 2020 detect neutral V and predict VO in equilibrium.
detections.abstract_quote: We conclude that scattering by high-altitude haze alone is unlikely to account for this difference, and instead interpret it as evidence for titanium oxide and vanadium oxide absorption.

reference.title: Detection of H2O and Evidence for TiO/VO in an Ultra-hot Exoplanet Atmosphere

detections.note: Tentative: the abstract says the 1.12-1.3 micron opacity is 'possibly due to iron hydride absorption' and 'If confirmed'. No later confirmation was verified here.
detections.abstract_quote: Enhanced opacity is also inferred across the 1.12-1.3 micron wavelength range, possibly due to iron hydride absorption.

detections.abstract_quote: We identify and spectrally resolve absorption from the Mg ii doublet in the planetary exosphere at a 5.9-σ confidence level.

detections.abstract_quote: We also detect and resolve strong features of the Fe ii UV1 and UV2 multiplets, and observe the lines reaching altitudes of Rpl/Rstar≈0.3.
